chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Humayd ibn al-Ziyad, from Ibn Sama'ah, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskhan, from Abu Basir, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'The woman who is not permissible to her husband until she marries another husband.' He said: 'She is the one who is divorced, then reconciled, then divorced, then reconciled, then divorced for the third time; she is the one who is not permissible to her husband

key_terms.مُرَاجَعَة: Reconciliation/Retaking (in the context of divorce before consummation or during waiting period)
key_terms.يَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَهَا: He tastes her sweetness (idiom for consummation)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for a woman to become permissible to her first husband after three divorces?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific case of a woman who becomes permanently prohibited to her first husband after three divorces (khula' or talaq). It explains that she only becomes permissible again if she marries another man, consummates the marriage, and then divorces or dies, before marrying the first husband again.
